scope: Two independent authenticated Chromium processes on public HTTPS/WSS; software GPU and DPR0.15, functional evidence, not gaming-PC performance or physical controller certification
diagnosis: Initial public harness selected an already active vehicle, then immediately pressed Ready while its account save was still pending. Late duplicate vehicle/paint messages cleared both readiness flags. Start remained disabled; no race started. Fix: idempotent server selections and disable Ready until account save plus authoritative selection acknowledgement.
